name: Banana Weevil (Corm Weevil)
description: A serious pest of plantain and banana that attacks the corm, causing tunneling damage, reduced plant vigor, and plant toppling. It is one of the most economically important pests of banana and plantain in Africa.
symptoms: Tunnels and galleries inside the corm
Stunted growth and reduced bunch size
Plants toppling over in wind due to damaged root system
Dark exudate from weevil entry holes at base
Adult weevils found at base of plant or in crop residue
treatments: Apply imidacloprid or chlorpyrifos to corm base at planting
Use neem cake or neem oil around plant base as repellent
Set pseudostem traps (split pseudostem pieces) to attract and kill adults
Clean-trap: collect and destroy adult weevils from traps weekly
prevention: Plant clean, uninfested suckers — pare off outer layers before planting
Hot water treat suckers (54°C for 15-20 minutes) before planting
Remove and destroy crop residue after harvest
Keep field clean of volunteer plants and debris
Use tissue-culture plantlets which are weevil-free
